account_signals: Month-end AP close deadline (1,200 invoices queued)
customer_reply:
Hello,

We are aware of an active incident (INC-26-0418) causing invoice OCR jobs to fail with error E-4102 following release 26.2.3. Our engineering team is currently working on a hotfix for this issue.

As a temporary workaround for your month-end processing:
1. You can switch affected invoice channels to Manual Entry mode under Admin > eInvoice > Channels.
2. Hold month-end OCR batches until the hotfix is deployed, or process critical invoices manually.

Please do not re-upload invoices or clear caches as this will not resolve the issue. We will update you as soon as further news or a fix is available.
